query: How do I check the status of my Singapore citizenship, Permanent Residence and/or Long-Term Visit Pass application if I do not have SingPass?
reference_answer: If you have submitted your application on or after 26 June 2024, you may log in to the ICA e-Service with your reference number to check the status of your Singapore Citizenship, Permanent Residence or Long-Term Visit Pass application.You will be redirected to the Case Summary page where you can check your status enquiry.
answer: To check the status of your Singapore citizenship, Permanent Residence, or Long-Term Visit Pass application without SingPass, visit the Immigration & Checkpoints Authority (ICA) website, call their hotline, or go to an ICA office in person. [Document 1]
